Conditional Survival Over Planned Future Periods Given History

Source: R/G2G_varying_posterior_functions.R
G2G_varying_cond_survival.Rd

For a customer who has survived the periods in a covariate history, computes the probability of surviving each of the next s periods under a planned covariate path: \(P(T > t + k \mid T > t)\) for \(k = 1, \dots, s\).

Usage

G2G_varying_cond_survival(solution, X_hist, X_future)

Arguments

solution

A fitted model of class "G2Gcov" returned by G2G_varying_MLE. Its par holds r, alpha and the coefficients on the original covariate scale (alpha already absorbs the centering used in fitting), so X_mat needs no centering or scaling.

X_hist

Covariate values for each period the customer has survived, one row per period, in any of the forms accepted by X_mat in G2G_varying_survival. The history must contain only event-free periods. NULL (no history) gives the unconditional survival curve for the planned path.

X_future

Planned covariate values for the periods to forecast, one row per future period (periods t + 1, ..., t + s), in the same form as X_hist. At least one row is required.

Value

Numeric vector of length s + 1: a leading 1 (no additional periods), then the probability of surviving 1, 2, ..., s additional periods given survival through the history.

Details

The customer's history updates the distribution of the baseline rate to \(\mathrm{Gamma}(r, \alpha + C(t))\), and averaging the future survival over that posterior gives $$P(T > t + k \mid T > t) = \left(\frac{\alpha + C(t)}{\alpha + C(t + k)}\right)^r,$$ where \(C(m) = \sum_{j=1}^{m} e^{z(j)\beta'}\) accumulates the history and then the planned covariates. This equals \(S(t + k) / S(t)\) from G2G_varying_survival for the combined path. The history length \(t\) and the horizon \(s\) are taken from the number of rows of X_hist and X_future.

Examples

# \donttest{
  data(kb_data)
  kb_data$status <- 1L - kb_data$censor
  fit <- G2G_varying_MLE(
    "Surv(week, status) ~ coupon + anyp",
    data    = kb_data,
    subject = "id"
  )
  # Survived 8 weeks; plan 4 more weeks with a coupon and no other promotion
  hist   <- kb_data[kb_data$id == kb_data$id[1], c("coupon", "anyp")][1:8, ]
  future <- data.frame(coupon = rep(1, 4), anyp = rep(0, 4))
  G2G_varying_cond_survival(fit, hist, future)
